HxResult HxLabelDelete ( HxLabel_t *  pLabel  ) 

Delete a label widget.

HxLabelDelete deletes a label created from an earlier call to HxLabelNew.

It is not necessary to call this function when quitting the application, since the widget's parent calls this function just before the parent is deleted. HxLabelDelete only needs to be called when deleting a label at runtime.

Parameters:
pLabel IN: Pointer to the label to delete
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxLabelNew ( uint32_t  id,
HxWidget_t *  pParent,
const HxRectangle_t *  pBounds,
HxFont_t *  pFont,
const char *  pText,
HxLabel_t **  hLabel 
)

Create a label widget.

HxLabelNew creates a new label widget. The application is responsible for defining the position of the label, but it can let the toolkit compute the height and width by passing 0 for those members of the pBounds rect structure. If the label's string extends beyond the bounds, it is clipped.

The standard system font is used if pFont is NULL.

Parameters:
id IN: Unique ID for the widget, defined by app, or kHxWidgetAutoID to auto-generate the ID
pParent IN: Pointer to "parent" widget containing label
pBounds IN: Pointer to the label bounding rectangle. If width or height is 0, they will be computed for you based on the text and the font selected for the label.
pFont IN: HxFont_t pointer or NULL to use standard font.
pText IN: pointer to a string
hLabel OUT: Handle to the new label; *hLabel is NULL on failure
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_MEMORY_ERROR if memory allocation fails, and sets *hLabel to NULL.

HxResult HxLabelSetAttributes ( HxLabel_t *  pLabel,
HxTextFlags_t  attributes 
)

Set the text attributes of a label.

HxLabelSetAttributes sets the text attributes of a label. The text attributes are a HxTextFlags_t value, defined in hxgraphics.h. HxLabelNew sets the label's attributes to the default value of kHxDefaultTextFlags (left aligned, with the text origin relative to the top left corner of the label's bounds).

Parameters:
pLabel IN: Pointer to the label
attributes IN: HxTextFlags_t
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_INVALID_ARG if attributes is invalid.
